tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Fetch a single order by its identifier. This tool retrieves an order from the Acme Orders database using the order ID. Use this tool whenever you need to look up an order. It returns the full order object including items, totals, customer reference, shipping address, payment status, fulfillment status, and the complete event history. Example: to look up order ord_123 call get_order with {"order_id": "ord_123"} and you will receive {"id": "ord_123", "status": "shipped", "items": [{"sku": "ABC-123", "quantity": 2, "price": 1999}], "total": 3998, "customer": "cus_9", "events": [{"type": "created", "at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}, {"type": "paid", "at": "2026-01-01T00:01:00Z"}, {"type": "shipped", "at": "2026-01-02T09:00:00Z"}]}. Another example: to look up order ord_456 call get_order with {"order_id": "ord_456"}. Another example: to look up order ord_789 call get_order with {"order_id": "ord_789"}. Remember that order IDs always start with ord_ and are case sensitive.
